svg.aria-label: The four scorers on two renders with output type, direction, model and role
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: The four scorers on the same two renders: a mug and a wine glass, seed 11
BLIP backbone and MLP; size unknown
R1, R3, R5; carries the verdict
All four put the render with both objects above the render with no mug. They disagree on the size of the gap and on what kind of answer they give: three numbers and one yes or no.
The number scales differ, so a gap in one row cannot be compared with a gap in another. Within a row, a higher number or a pass is the better render.

Numbers: the probe CSVs copied from the repository, measured at the protocol's settings. Models and roles: the review protocol and the papers; "size unknown" means no file I read states the input size.
